#1019 · Apple Hydra Pokémon

Hydrapple

Grass Dragon

Paldea · Generation 9

Hydrapple is a Grass/Dragon-type Apple Hydra Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 93 kg. It evolves from Dipplin. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (120), with a base stat total of 540.
